head: Filtered
should never
mean deleted
body: We shipped a filter that threw away bad GPS. Months later someone asked whether it was working.
I could not answer. The evidence was gone.

head: We threw away
*its testimony
slides.caption: Dropping a bad reading destroys the only evidence that could have told you whether dropping it was correct.

head: You cannot tune
a filter you
*cannot audit
body: And you cannot audit what you deleted.
If your pipeline drops rows, know where they go. "Nowhere" is an answer, just not a good one.
